scenes.speech: Install Own it. Then run the login command and sign in with GitHub in your browser.
Run the key command. Choose Nebius or NVIDIA, and paste your API key at the hidden prompt.
In your project, run Own it init. Install the GitHub app for that repo when prompted. Setup is done.
You've added a search box to your shop. Push your code, and choose yes to start the interview.
Why did you add a search box to the shop? So customers can quickly find the product they want.
What happens when someone searches for shoes? The shop only shows products with shoes in the name.
Both answers passed. Your push is verified. Two short answers to explain the code you ship.
